title: Mid-Year Upgrades on Northgate Memberships
content:
**Right to upgrade.** A member may upgrade a Northgate Memberships membership during the membership year to the tier's upgrade target where the tier allows a mid-year upgrade; Northgate Student Club Membership, Northgate Club Plus Membership and Northgate Business Plus Membership cannot be upgraded mid-year.

**Status.** An upgrade is processed only on a membership whose status is active, as shown on the membership record.

| Status on the membership record | Upgrade |
|---|---|
| active | may be processed |
| expired | not processed |
| suspended | not processed |
| cancelled | not processed |
| closed | not processed |

**Effect of an upgrade.**

1. The upgrade difference fee is charged on the upgrade date.
2. The expiry date does not change.
3. Annual Reward accrues only on qualifying purchases made on or after the upgrade date — purchases earlier in the year are not rewarded retroactively.
4. A Northgate Heroes Club Membership upgraded to Northgate Club Plus Membership no longer needs status verification.
5. The household card and any add-on cards move to the new tier with the membership at no charge.

**Segments.** Moving a membership between the consumer and business segments is not an upgrade: it requires a new membership in the other segment.

## Hypothetical cases

- A Club membership upgraded on 10 June: a qualifying purchase made on 9 June earns no Annual Reward; one made on 10 June earns at the Plus rate.
- A Business membership with three add-on cards upgraded to Business Plus: the three add-on cards and the household card move with the membership; no card fee arises from the move.
- A Club Plus member who wants Business Plus: this is a move between segments and is not an upgrade; it requires a new business membership.
- A Heroes Club membership upgraded to Club Plus: the membership no longer needs service verification from the upgrade on.
